item.title: Alcatraz Makes History with First-Ever Live Super Bowl Broadcast from the Iconic Island
item.description: One of the most famous islands in the world is stepping into a brand-new spotlight.Alcatraz Island will appear on live sports television for the first time ever this Sunday, as NBC Sports broadcasts part of its Super Bowl pregame coverage directly from the historic site.Known as a former prison, Civil War fort, and now a national park, Alcatraz has long been featured in movies and history books. item.title: Gold Prices Swing as Investors Watch Market Volatility in Munich and Beyond
item.description: Gold has long been viewed as one of the world’s safest investments, a store of value that investors turn to during uncertainty. But in 2026, the precious metal is behaving very differently.After smashing through record highs late last year, gold posted its biggest single-day drop on record in January. item.description: If you’re searching for a fun and healthy way to spend Valentine’s Day weekend, Planet Fitness is opening its doors for free workouts nationwide.From Feb. 14 through Feb. 15, all U.S. Planet Fitness locations will offer complimentary access to their fitness centers, welcoming people of all fitness levels to join in. item.title: Tour de Palm Springs returns for 28th year, bringing riders and road closures to downtown
